chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from a man, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: The people say that if a man performs salat (prayer) while his buttons are undone and his hands are inside the shirt, then he is only praying as one naked. He said: There is no harm.

key_terms.أَزْرَارُهُ: his buttons or fastenings on the garment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) with shirt buttons undone and hands inside the garment?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal question about performing salat (prayer) with one's buttons undone and one's hands inside the garment. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that there is no harm in this, indicating that such a posture does not invalidate the prayer.
